name: Cult Unveiled
legend: Many Genestealer Cults seek to spread beyond their birth worlds by smuggling broods of the faithful onto departing voidships. Though cunning, some such cult cells are discovered before they reach their destinations. In such circumstances, they will fight furiously to overtake their host vessel entirely.

rules.name: Harassing Fire
rules.legend: Focusing on hit-and-fade tactics to wear their enemies down, the guerrilla fighters of the cult hammer the foe with swift volleys before vanishing back behind closing hatches.
rules.description_html: At the encl of your Shooting phase, you can select one GENESTEALER CULTS unit from your army that is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units. If you do, that unit can attempt to operate one open Hatchway it is within 1" of (if there is one), and can then make a Normal move of up to 3" (regardless of whether it attempted to operate a Hatchway or not). Until the end of the turn, that unit is not eligible to declare a charge.

stratagems.name: LURKING MENACE
stratagems.legend: Foes find their aim confounded as the Genestealer Cultists prowl through gloom and drifting steam, rarely presenting themselves as targets.
stratagems.description_html:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

TARGET: One GENESTEALER CULTS unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, if the attacking model is not within 3", subtract 1 from the Hit roll.

stratagems.name: FOR THE BROOD
stratagems.legend: Fanatical, and with wills suborned by the insidious Broodmind, these cultists will gladly die amidst hails of their comrades’fire if it means victory.
stratagems.description_html:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase.

TARGET: One GENESTEALER CULTS unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.

EFFECT: Select one enemy unit within Engagement Range of one or more friendly GENESTEALER CULTS units. Until the end of the phase, your unit can make ranged attacks that target that enemy unit. If it does, after your unit has finished making those attacks, roll one D6 for each of those friendly units: on a 2-4, that friendly unit suffers 1 mortal wound; on a 5+, that friendly unit suffers 2 mortal wounds.

stratagems.name: OUT OF HIDING
stratagems.legend: Wary of detection, the cult has concealed cells of the faithful through the structure of the ship. Now they emerge into the fight like insects from their cocoon.
stratagems.description_html:
WHEN: Your Movement phase, at the start of the Reinforcements step.

TARGET: One NEOPHYTE HYBRIDS unit from your army that is in Reserves.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have the Deep Strike ability.

RESTRICTIONS: You can only use this Stratagem once.

stratagems.name: PLANNED EXTRACTION
stratagems.legend: Driven by the Broodmind and their own guerrilla training, these cultists refuse open battle, instead firing hails of cover fire as they retreat into the shadows.
stratagems.description_html:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase.

TARGET: One GENESTEALER CULTS unit from your army.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, your unit is eligible to shoot in a turn in which it Fell Back.

enhancements.name: Master Saboteur
enhancements.legend: This cult leader is skilled in the arts of covert sabotage, and has pre-emptively employed these skills against a key strategic target on this deck.
enhancements.description_html: The first time in the battle that your opponent’s army Secures an objective marker while the bearer is on the battlefield, roll one D6: on a 3+, that objective marker is not Secured by your opponent’s army.

enhancements.name: Primary Detonator
enhancements.legend: A chunky technological device with a deviant machine spirit and an array of triggers, this jury-rigged detonator connects to multiple explosive charges laced through this deck. By pumping one of the triggers, its wielder can set off a powerful detonation.
enhancements.description_html: Once per battle, when an enemy unit opens a closed Hatchway, if the bearer is on the battlefield, it can use this Enhancement. If it does, roll one D6: on a 3-4, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound; on a 5+, that enemy unit suffers 2 mortal wounds.
